The '''Mrisst system''', also known as the '''GaTir system''', was located less than five standard hours from the [[Pyria system]].<ref name="X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> It was used as a staging area for [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis's]] forces before the [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Yaga Minor]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

The [[Mriss/Legends|Mrissi]] home [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Mrisst/Legends|Mrisst]], was in this system.<ref name="Alien Encounters" />
